rites.name: Vesyushith
rites.text: Vesyushith is the concept of resonance that moved through Veniolora during the Singing, when the first roots pulled the scattered sound of the void into the shape of living wood. It is remembered as the pattern that taught the young groves how to hold a note long enough to become a forest.

rites.name: Tolium
rites.text: Tolium is the concept of a resonant hum that the first roots of Veniolora gave off as they condensed, a tone later read by the orders as the origin of flame and temple-song. Its power is less a blast than a slow pull that draws loose matter into forms the Holy Age could name and worship.

rites.name: Xaivsis
rites.text: Xaivsis is the concept of a binding oath that the Courts of Veniolora used to hold worlds to their trials and treaties. In the Age of Sundering it became the seal that kept the doors between worlds from tearing open when landfall broke old bonds.

rites.name: Vorournoth
rites.text: Vorournoth is the concept of the Weave as it is planted in Veniolora, the quiet binding that lets latent powers sleep under the growing groves. It belongs to the Seeding, when the first sovereign's kingdoms rise among the new trees and no power yet wakes beyond ordinary strength.

rites.name: Krouthaggok
rites.text: Krouthaggok is a concept of Veniolora, a binding of Arcane pact-law that the orders of the Holy Age set down to hold shattered worlds together after the Sundering. It is remembered as the doctrine that made flame and temple answerable to a single oath. Its power is written in the Shards that still answer to it.

rites.name: Elemalae
rites.text: Elemalae is a bonded arcane current woven through the dreams of Veniolora's sleepers, a force that stirs when a mind's inner sight grows wide enough to shape the waking world. Its practitioners learn to draw the current into sigils and storms, though none can yet say where the current itself originates.

rites.name: Oriana
rites.text: Oriana is a shimmering conjured phantom of cerulean fire, able to drift through solid matter or condense into a narrow lance of light. Those who glimpse her in the dreamlands say she can be witnessed only by a handful of watchers at once, lest her glow overwhelm them.

rites.name: Krurkoth
rites.text: Krurkoth is the concept of the branching hinge in Veniolora's Three Futures, the moment where the ending splits and the Library must shelve each outcome separately. It is not a being with a will but a pressure felt as the weight of unchosen paths. Its presence is recorded in the Arcane Realm of the seventh era as a faint tremor in what might have been.

rites.name: Tarnedoldar
rites.text: Tarnedoldar is the concept of the Veniolora branch-tide, the moment in the Three Futures when a single ending splits into many and the Library of Veniolora is obliged to shelve each outcome beside the others. It is not a being but a principle of arrangement, felt as a tightening of the shelves before a choice is made.
